changelog:
mp-prototype v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "prototype" skill for building quick, throwaway prototypes to test designs and ideas.
- Supports two branches: state logic prototypes (interactive terminal apps) and UI exploration prototypes (multiple switchable UI variants).
- Provides clear rules for creating, locating, and marking prototypes as disposable.
- Enforces in-memory state and surface state changes for easy inspection.
- Guidelines ensure prototypes are easy to run, minimal, and never intended for production use.
- Includes instructions for capturing learnings and cleaning up prototypes after use.
